step1.description:
We started a journey almost a year ago to look at what the future of Signals looks like. It's led to a ton of experimentation and writeups. Today I am very excited to give you the first peak at that future. 

Banner Credit: Thank you to Andrea Ciani for his worked entitled "Sci-fi Signals in geometry nodes" for providing images for non-commercial use.
